sloka: एतत्तवार्या नृपराजसिंह सीता वचः प्राह विषादपूर्वम् ।एतच्च बुद्ध्वा गदितं मया त्वं श्रद्धत्स्व सीतां कुशलां समग्राम् ।। ५.६७.३८ ।।
transliteration: etattavāryā nṛparājasiṁha sītā vacaḥ prāha viṣādapūrvam ।etacca buddhvā gaditaṁ mayā tvaṁ śraddhatsva sītāṁ kuśalāṁ samagrām ।। 5.67.38 ।।

translations.english: "'And formerly, hero, I was touched upon the limbs by the rakshasa; what could I do therein, sore pressed by time?
